_meta.schema: exact: model-key -> {family, arch, summary, recipe, source, notes}. recipe: {sampler, scheduler (token, or null when the template drives sampling with a dedicated scheduler NODE), scheduler_node (that node's type, or null), steps, cfg}. source: {kind, template (only on kind=vendor-default — the template file as ComfyUI ships it), url (for a vendor artifact that is not a shipped template)}.
_meta.purpose: The one home for each model family's default sampling recipe. It used to live duplicated in samplers.json and schedulers.json good_for prose — 'Krea 2 Turbo: euler + simple, 8 steps, CFG 1' was written into BOTH euler.good_for and simple.good_for, two copies with no source of truth. Stored once here, cited to the template it came from, and re-verified against that template by `just corpus-check`: if upstream changes the template, the check fails. See .claude/rules/corpus-ground-truth.md.
_meta.not_a_catalogue: This is authoring and validation infrastructure, not a model index. It carries the handful of families the corpus already makes claims about — enough to keep those claims honest. Nothing in the UI reads it yet.

krea2-turbo.summary: 8-step distilled checkpoint. Qwen3VL-4B text encoder, qwen_image_vae — a distinct model from FLUX.1 Krea dev despite the shared name.
krea2-turbo.notes: Secondary guides recommending er_sde for this model contradict the shipped template, which says euler.

krea2-raw.summary: The undistilled Raw/Base variant of Krea 2 — many more steps and real CFG, unlike the Turbo checkpoint.
krea2-raw.notes: ComfyUI ships NO template for the Raw variant, so there is no vendor default to cite and the step/CFG figures are deliberately left null rather than invented. Community reports put it around 52 steps at CFG 3.5-4.5. We know this model less well than the Turbo one, and the schema says so.

flux1-krea-dev.summary: FLUX.1 dev finetuned by Krea. Guidance-distilled, so it runs at CFG 1 with the guidance value baked into the conditioning.

flux2-klein-distilled.summary: The distilled FLUX.2 Klein checkpoint — a few-step model run through the custom-sampling chain.
flux2-klein-distilled.notes: The FLUX.2 templates do NOT use a scheduler token: sampling is driven by a dedicated Flux2Scheduler node, so there is no simple/normal/beta to recommend here. Earlier corpus prose claiming 'FLUX.2 Klein with simple/normal' had no basis in what ComfyUI actually ships.

flux2-klein-base.summary: The undistilled FLUX.2 Klein base checkpoint — full step count and real CFG.
flux2-klein-base.notes: Same template as the distilled variant — it ships both as separate subgraphs.

qwen-image-edit-2511.summary: Instruction-driven image editing model. The 2511 revision runs at a full step count; the Lightning LoRA variants collapse it to 4 steps at CFG 1.

wan22-14b-t2v.summary: Wan 2.2 14B text-to-video. The shipped template is the Lightning-distilled configuration — 4 steps at CFG 1.
wan22-14b-t2v.notes: This is the recipe for core's KSampler path. WanVideoWrapper exposes its own scheduler tokens (unipc, dpm++, ...) which are a different widget entirely — see schedulers.json.

wan22-5b-ti2v.summary: Wan 2.2 5B text/image-to-video. Undistilled, so it wants a real step count and real CFG.

sdxl.summary: The legacy latent-diffusion class. Unlike the rectified-flow models it wants a real CFG scale, and karras/sgm_uniform usually beat the plain schedules.
sdxl.notes: The template's euler + normal is the conservative starting point ComfyUI ships, not the community's favourite — dpmpp_2m + karras is the usual workhorse on this architecture.

sd15.summary: The original Stable Diffusion class. Same story as SDXL: real CFG, and karras-family schedules earn their keep.
sd15.notes: The recipe is unchanged and still correct — what changed is that it can no longer be machine-verified, so the label had to stop claiming otherwise. It was cited as `vendor-default` / `default.json` on 2026-08-04 (#80). Two days later Comfy-Org/workflow_templates#1088 (commit 5097de61, 2026-08-06, "Archive Getting Started category and Reve templates") moved `templates/default.json` to `archived/default.json`, so the shipped template set no longer contains it and `just corpus-check` had nothing to check against. The archived file still carries `v1-5-pruned-emaonly-fp16.safetensors` with KSampler widgets [seed, 'randomize', 20, 8, 'euler', 'normal', 1] — exactly these values. `vendor-default` in this corpus means specifically "a template ComfyUI ships", which this no longer is; it is still vendor-authored and vendor-published, hence `vendor-doc` rather than `community`, which would misattribute the numbers to third parties who did not produce them. ComfyUI ships no SD1.5 template today, and its built-in default graph is now Z-Image Turbo, so there is nothing to re-derive from.
